new_categories.label: manifold_line_instrument_readiness
new_categories.memory: Manifold/transfer-line instrumentation readiness can be represented separately from transfer machinery, valve actuation and physical connection readiness.

new_categories.label: pressure_measurement_confidence_non_numeric
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric pressure-measurement confidence state can be tracked without retaining values, ranges, thresholds or operating implications.

new_categories.label: temperature_measurement_confidence_non_numeric
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric temperature-measurement confidence state is distinct from exact cargo temperature values or tank-heating setpoints.

new_categories.label: indication_availability_confidence
new_categories.memory: Indication availability can degrade independently from the underlying sensing element or the physical transfer path.

new_categories.label: measurement_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measurement validity/confidence is a separate state from whether an indication is merely present.

new_categories.label: cross_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate cross-check confidence can be represented abstractly without inferring calibration methods or acceptance criteria.

new_categories.label: manifold_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: Instrumentation degradation can be scoped to a manifold/interface domain rather than generalized to all transfer instrumentation.

new_categories.label: transfer_line_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: A transfer-line segment or measurement domain can carry its own confidence/restriction state without exposing exact topology.

new_categories.label: instrument_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, signal or support dependency confidence can be tracked separately from delivered measurement validity without inferring exact architecture.

new_categories.label: instrumentation_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Instrumentation service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_instrument_restriction_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can be attributed to an instrument, indication domain, validity domain, support dependency or manifold/line scope.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_measurement_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Transfer restriction, terminal incompatibility, containment concern, rework or schedule effects do not alone prove an instrument, indication, validity or support root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_measurement_restoration
new_categories.memory: Instrument repair, indication return, validity confirmation, cross-check completion and operational release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: tank_gauging_vs_manifold_line_instrumentation
useful_refinements.memory: P095 tank level/quantity gauging is related measurement vocabulary but does not duplicate pressure/temperature instrumentation at manifold/transfer-line scope.

useful_refinements.label: transfer_flow_confidence_vs_measurement_validity
useful_refinements.memory: P092 transfer-flow confidence is refined by distinguishing delivered transfer performance from instrumentation measurement validity.

useful_refinements.label: physical_connection_vs_instrumentation
useful_refinements.memory: P102 physical connection and containment readiness do not establish manifold/line instrument readiness or measurement validity.

useful_refinements.label: generic_monitoring_vs_typed_measurement_domains
useful_refinements.memory: Generic monitoring mechanics refine this family, while pressure/temperature measurement and validity remain distinct confidence domains.

duplicates.label: generic_instrument_condition_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic instrument/equipment condition and restoration mechanics repeat prior measurement and service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_degradation_and_verification
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and verification mechanics are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact instrument types, locations or ranges
exact pressure/temperature values, thresholds or setpoints
exact alarm logic, calibration values, testing or adjustment methods
named provider, terminal, incident or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact manifold/transfer-line instrument arrangements, instrument types, ranges, pressure/temperature values, thresholds, setpoints, alarm logic, calibration data, test values and current configuration
exact calibration, testing, adjustment, alarm-response, transfer-monitoring, troubleshooting or operating procedures
named instrumentation/calibration providers, terminals, inspectors, incidents, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional instrumentation service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact values, setpoints, calibration, testing, procedure, provider or incident detail that is deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive manifold/transfer-line instrumentation service-state orientation/source-discovery output; not calibration, alarm-response, testing, cargo-transfer or operating advice and not proof of any exact instrument, range, value, threshold, setpoint, logic, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
